kids: 🚀 A HUGE new game: trade, fight and explore a whole galaxy of 160 star systems!
🛸 Dock with spinning space stations — by hand, or let the docking computer do it
🗳️ Special missions can change how a planet is ruled — forever!
💾 Your space career is saved, so you can carry on next time
items: 🚀 New in the secret arcade: Starlane Trader — an original space-trading game in the style of the 1984 wireframe classics, with trading, missions, docking and hyperspace. Your career is saved.

kids: 🔔 The app now tells you when there’s a new version — and what’s new!
items: 🔔 When online, the app checks for a new version and shows what has changed, with simple steps to save and update.

kids: 🧩 A brand-new puzzle game in the secret arcade…
👥 Play with a friend, brother or sister — two-player modes!
🏆 Top-5 high-score tables with your name
items: ⓘ Hover help: hover over (or tap ⓘ beside) any setting in Admin, the Parent dashboard and Voices, and the main buttons, to see what it does.
🤫 The secret surprise now has two-player modes and one more game…

kids: ✅ Hints and methods now show every single step
items: ✅ Quality check of every question, hint, worked method and lesson. Hints and methods now show EVERY step of the working — for example, in ratio questions, “divide the total by the number of parts” is always shown with the actual sum.
🤫 Three more surprises for players who put the work in…

kids: 🎨 Loads more ways to make your player look like you — hair, skin tones, head coverings and more
items: 🎨 More ways to make your player look like you: boy or girl, 10 skin tones, 13 hair styles (including afro, braids, locs, two puffs, bob and bun), 11 hair colours, eye shapes, and head coverings (hijab, patka, dastar, kippah, headwrap).
💾 The save bar shows your progress file’s name and when it was last saved — hover over it (or the Save button) to see where it is. New “Save as…” and “⬇️ Export (.json)” buttons.
📄 Links to Tiffin School’s official sample maths questions and admissions page (Help and the bottom of the page).
🤖 A clear note that the app was made with AI and isn’t affiliated with Tiffin School.

kids: 🕹️ The secret surprise got a full arcade makeover!
items: 🤫 The secret surprise got a proper arcade makeover…

✨ Natural-sounding voices are now used automatically wherever the device has them (for example Edge’s “Online (Natural)” voices on Windows, or Enhanced/Premium voices on iPad and Mac) — mixing female and male, or sharing a voice, if there aren’t four.

🎙️ Choose any voice your device has for each job — tour guide, announcer, question reader and teacher (🎙️ Voices → Voice for each job). Choices are saved; if a voice isn’t on another device, Automatic is used there.

🔊 Reading aloud: tap 🔊 to hear a question, an explainer, a worked method, a Learn step or an example read out. Different voices for the tour, announcements, questions and teaching — choose female or male voices and the speed in 🎙️ Voices.
📣 Announcements (celebrations, tips and answer feedback) can be read out — the 🔊 / 🔇 button at the top turns them on or off.
🗺️ The tours now read themselves aloud and move on automatically, with a pause button. The grown-ups’ tour now opens the Parent dashboard and explains each tab, especially the Focus areas.

🎓 A guided tour of the app — one for players and one for grown-ups — offered with a welcome screen the first time, and always available from ❓ Help. Choose “Don’t ask me again” to stop the welcome screen (saved with your progress).
